title: Vapouriz 50/50 Apple & Mixed Berries 10ml
description: Apple & Mixed Berries brings together crisp Green Apple and a selection of juicy red and dark berries for a layered, fruit-forward vape. The Apple adds a clean, slightly tart edge, while the mixed berries lend sweetness and depth for a well-rounded and refreshing experience. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid offers smooth flavour delivery and subtle vapour production, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits, vape pens, and starter setups. Produced in the UK by Vapouriz Labs, the Vapouriz 50/50 range is crafted to deliver reliable, satisfying flavour across a variety of devices. With its balanced PG/VG formulation, this e-liquid is a great option for vapers seeking flavour clarity without excessive cloud output. The 50/50 formulation refers to a balanced mix of Vegetable Glycerine and Propylene Glycol, providing both smooth vapour and bold flavour—suitable for use in most beginner and crossover vape kits.
